item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00277","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C16","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"literal_language_template","rationale":"C08 supplies a concrete drafting model for the child: both identify persons reaching the retirement age prescribed for automatic separation under the Civil Service Retirement Act, invoke the President's judgment that the public interest requires an exemption, and directly exempt the covered person or persons from retirement. The child adapts this individual-exemption formula into a temporary class-wide exemption. C16 is also close in vocabulary and covered population but concerns revoking exemptions; C07 follows the same individual-exemption preamble but its supplied text omits the operative exemption provision.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"officers and employees in the executive branch ... who reach the retirement age prescribed for automatic separation from the service ... are hereby exempted from automatic separation","parent_excerpt":"William D. Hassett ... will ... reach the retirement age ... prescribed for automatic separation from the service by the Civil Service Retirement Act ... I hereby exempt the said William D. Hassett from compulsory retirement for age","explanation":"The child generalizes C08's retirement-trigger and operative exemption language from one named officer to a defined class."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that certain officers and employees ... be exempted from automatic separation from the service as provided below","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that such person be exempted from compulsory retirement for age as provided below","explanation":"This is a closely matching and relatively distinctive recital introducing the same exemption mechanism."},{"child_excerpt":"until October 31, 1956","parent_excerpt":"for an indefinite period of time","explanation":"Both provisions specify the duration of the presidential retirement exemption, with the child substituting a fixed temporary endpoint."}]}
